display_title: Ah, I Want to Be in a Relationship
description:
Jio, a mundane office worker with a bland and monotonous life, resembling low-fat milk. The only joy in his life is gaming, but everything changes when the ultra-gorgeous Soha appears before him. His dormant love cells awaken. Meanwhile, Yujin, a new employee at the company where Jio works, also secretly harbors feelings for him. Can the expert of timid one-sided love overcome their own limitations(?) and conquer love?
